event.title: Mexican TikTok Influencer Shot Dead During Livestream
event.canonical_title: Mexican TikTok Influencer Shot Dead During Livestream
event.summary: César Gastelum, a Mexican TikTok influencer with nearly 600,000 followers, was shot dead during a livestream outside a restaurant in Sinaloa state. The attack occurred at close range by an assailant on a motorbike, highlighting ongoing concerns about gang violence in the region.

timeline.title: Mexican Influencer César Gastélum Killed During Live Stream
timeline.summary: César Gastélum, a popular Mexican social media influencer, was shot and killed while live streaming outside a fast-food restaurant in Culiacán, Sinaloa. The incident occurred on Tuesday evening, and Gastélum had nearly 600,000 followers on TikTok, where he was known for his comedy videos. He was reportedly attacked by a motorbike driver while filming with two friends.
